verdict.rationale: monday.com's own marketing for its AI agents says they can automate status updates and reports and spot progress gaps, which directly addresses AI-drafted status updates. The evidence is only brief marketing taglines, with no documentation of how drafts are built from recent board activity or how users review and edit them. missing for 10: documented detail on generating updates from recent activity, a draft/review workflow, project- or initiative-level scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity

citations.quote: Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
Spot risks and progress gaps before they become problems.
Surface deep intelligence and actionable insights from any subject.
